name: @rbt/office
description: Fable-compiled office libraries for browser applications

scripts._restore: dotnet tool restore && for proj in src/Word src/ShaperText src/Office.Formats src/Spreadsheet src/FableUI src/Word.Pdf src/Spreadsheet.Pdf; do (cd $proj && dotnet restore >/dev/null); done
scripts.build:fable: dotnet tool restore && rm -rf dist && dotnet fable src/Word --outDir dist/word --lang JavaScript --noCache && dotnet fable src/ShaperText --outDir dist/shaper-text --lang JavaScript --noCache && dotnet fable src/Office.Formats --outDir dist/office-formats --lang JavaScript --noCache && dotnet fable src/Spreadsheet --outDir dist/spreadsheet --lang JavaScript --noCache && dotnet fable src/FableUI --outDir dist/fable-ui --lang JavaScript --noCache && dotnet fable src/Word.Pdf --outDir dist/word-pdf --lang JavaScript --noCache && dotnet fable src/Spreadsheet.Pdf --outDir dist/spreadsheet-pdf --lang JavaScript --noCache && rm -f dist/*/fable_modules/.gitignore && node scripts/share-bundle-modules.mjs dist/word-pdf dist/word Pdf.js Browser.js && dotnet fsi scripts/stage-word-pdf-data.fsx dist/word-pdf && node scripts/share-bundle-modules.mjs dist/spreadsheet-pdf dist/spreadsheet Pdf.js && node scripts/alias-sibling-modules.mjs dist && cp -r fonts dist/fonts && node scripts/check-function-modules.mjs dist/spreadsheet && node scripts/check-start-up-modules.mjs dist/spreadsheet Spreadsheet.js,Toolbar.js,XlsxImporter.js 'MacroProject\.js$,MacroHost\.js$,Rbt\.Vb\.,^rbt-vb/' && node scripts/check-start-up-modules.mjs dist/word Word.js,WordShell.js,WordHost.js 'WordMacroProject\.js$,WordMacroHost\.js$,Rbt\.Vb\.,^rbt-vb/'
